paite: "Mihat aw, bang achia thil hihkhelh suang na hia! Pathian zahngaihna tung a gitlouhna bangziak a suang?
heading: Edom Mi Doeg, Saul Kiang A Va Hoh A, Ahimelek Inn Ah David Ahoh Chih Agen Nung A. David La / Pathian Thukhenna Leh Hehpihna

paite: Na lei in niteng in gilou-salou asuangtuah nak; mulmet tem hiamtak khemhat bang in.
Hoih sang in gilou na deihzaw a; diktatna thugen sang in zuauthu gen na deihzaw hi. Selah
Nang lei khemhat aw, thu mivalhtheite na deih hi.
"Pathian in tangtawn a ding in ahon hihse ding a, ahon man ding a, na omna a kipan in ahon kaikhe ding a, mihing gam a kipan ahon botkhe ek ding hi. Selah
Midiktatte'n leng amu un alau ding ua, anuihsan ding uh.
En dih uh, hiai mi ahi, akulhpi a Pathian nei nuam lou a, ahauhna thupi muang zaw a, gitlouh satlouhna akihihhat," chi in.
"Kei zaw, Pathian inn a olive sel liahliah bang ka hi, Pathian zahngaihna tangtawn tangtawn in ka muang ding hi.
Huai na hih ziak in, tangtawn in kipahthu ka hon hilh ding; na misiangthoute mitmuh ah na min ka ngak ding, ahoih ahi."
